resources.string: Recognition starts as soon as screen sharing is authorized. Tap × to stop recognition and return to the icon.

After sharing your screen, tap the floating icon to start recognition. Tap × to stop and return to the icon. While waiting, frames and text are not processed; system screen-sharing authorization stays active.
Standby. Tap the floating icon to start recognition.
Standby. The floating icon is hidden; restore it from the home screen.
Recognition is stopped. Tap the floating icon when you are ready.
Screen sharing remains authorized. Tap the icon to recognize; use Stop in this notification or the app to end sharing.
Stops recognition when the sequence ends and the input phase begins. Keeps the result and a Start recognition button.
Recognition stopped. The result is kept; tap Start recognition when ready.
Recognition stopped. The result window is hidden; restore it from the home screen.
Recognition is stopped and the result is kept. Tap Start recognition in the window for another round, or Stop to end screen sharing.
